name: Graphite gasket
description: High-temperature resistant gasket made from flexible graphite, ideal for industrial applications.
fullDescription: Our premium graphite gaskets are manufactured from high-purity expanded graphite, offering exceptional thermal stability and chemical resistance. These gaskets excel in extreme temperature environments and provide reliable sealing performance across a wide range of industrial applications including power generation, petrochemical processing, and high-temperature piping systems.

name: Asbestos gasket
description: Heat-resistant gasket made from asbestos fibers, suitable for high-pressure applications (Note: Restricted in some regions).
fullDescription: Traditional asbestos gaskets manufactured from compressed asbestos fiber with rubber binders. These gaskets provide excellent sealing properties for high-pressure and high-temperature applications. Please note: Use is restricted in many regions due to health regulations. Available only where legally permitted.
compliance: Use restricted in many countries - check local regulations

name: Non Asbestos gasket
description: Environmentally friendly gasket made from synthetic fibers, a safe alternative to asbestos.
fullDescription: Our non-asbestos gaskets are engineered using advanced aramid fibers and cellulose materials bonded with NBR rubber. These eco-friendly gaskets offer superior performance without the health risks associated with asbestos, making them ideal for modern industrial applications requiring both safety and reliability.

name: Ceramic gasket
description: Extremely durable and heat-resistant gasket, ideal for extreme temperature environments.
fullDescription: High-performance ceramic fiber gaskets designed for the most demanding thermal applications. Manufactured from premium alumina-silica ceramic fibers, these gaskets maintain their integrity and sealing properties even under extreme thermal stress, making them perfect for furnaces, kilns, and exhaust systems.

name: Rubber gasket
description: Flexible and waterproof gasket made from high-quality rubber, used for sealing applications.
fullDescription: Premium nitrile rubber (NBR) gaskets offering exceptional flexibility and sealing performance. These versatile gaskets are perfect for water, oil, and fuel applications across various industries. The superior elasticity ensures consistent sealing even under vibration and thermal cycling.

name: Spiral wound gasket
description: High-performance gasket with a spiral-wound metal and filler design, used in high-pressure systems.
fullDescription: Precision-engineered spiral wound gaskets featuring alternating layers of stainless steel and flexible graphite filler. This unique construction provides exceptional resilience and sealing capability for critical high-pressure and high-temperature applications in petrochemical, power generation, and process industries.

name: Teflon gasket
description: Non-stick and chemical-resistant gasket, ideal for food and pharmaceutical industries.
fullDescription: FDA-compliant PTFE gaskets offering unmatched chemical resistance and non-stick properties. These gaskets are the preferred choice for pharmaceutical, food processing, and chemical applications where purity and contamination prevention are critical. Virgin PTFE material ensures no leaching or contamination.

name: Rappit bandages
description: High-strength adhesive bandages used for sealing and insulation in industrial applications.
fullDescription: Industrial-grade self-vulcanizing rubber tape designed for emergency repairs, electrical insulation, and waterproofing. The unique self-fusing formula creates a permanent, seamless bond that withstands extreme conditions, making it essential for maintenance and repair operations.

name: Oil seal ring
description: Durable sealing ring designed to prevent oil leakage in engines and machinery.
fullDescription: Precision-molded oil seal rings featuring a reinforced metal case and high-performance elastomer lip. Engineered to provide reliable shaft sealing in rotating applications, preventing lubricant leakage while excluding contaminants. Perfect for automotive, industrial machinery, and hydraulic systems.
